notes: v529 — the lock screen now works properly on phones. If the password kept being refused on a phone while the same word worked on a computer, the cause was almost always your browser silently AUTOFILLING an old saved password into the box. Now: a 👁 show button so you can SEE exactly what is in the field, a character count, the box is cleared of anything autofilled, and hidden characters your keyboard can add (curly quotes, en-dashes, non-breaking or zero-width spaces) are repaired before sending — and the app says when it had to repair something. The “wrong password” message now names autofill as the likely culprit instead of blaming your typing. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
